newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Thames focuses on core business.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Thames focuses on core business.

text.p: British water and sewerage firm Thames Water, which supplies the capital city, is concentrating on its core business although it had a profit for the first time on non-core at interim, managing director Bill Alexander said.
"We are doing both (non-core and core), but our primary concern is the core and getting that right," he said in a telephone interview.

Thames Water turned in half year pretax profits of 176 million stg after exceptional items, up from 165.4 million stg previously, while profits before exceptionals were up 15 percent to 188 million stg.
